# Apollo

Apollo is a desktop agent from tsc.hk. The public site is https://apollo.tsc.hk
Source: https://github.com/tschk/apollo

You open the app, set it up in a few screens, and talk to it. Setup connects a
model, chooses where the agent may work, and sets when it should ask. Then you
pick simple (the conversation) or advanced (instances, tools, and a record of
what happened). You can keep more than one instance, each with its own model.
